title: Wells Fargo accelerates GenAI strategy authoring across retail banking
text: Wells Fargo is rolling out an internal GenAI assistant to help its strategy teams author Digital Strategy Documents (P1C1.1.1) and refresh Business Alignment (P1C1.1.2) artifacts on a quarterly cadence. The bank says the tool cuts authoring time by 40% and integrates with the existing Microsoft 365 stack. Northwestern Mutual is reportedly piloting a similar capability for compliance governance. The trend mirrors a wider shift in financial services toward composable AI strategy tooling.

title: OCC publishes 2026 guidance on Regulatory Change Management automation
text: The OCC has issued new guidance covering automated Regulatory Change Management (P1C2.7.1) systems. Banks are expected to maintain auditable change logs, real-time alert pipelines, and AI-assisted impact assessment workflows. The guidance signals broader supervisory interest in the operating model behind compliance automation across credit unions and asset managers.
